population: Unselected (relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma)
note: Sugemalimab (CS1001), tagitanlimab (KL-A167) and benmelstobart (TQB2450) entered phase 2 in relapsed cHL on the 9p24.1/PD-L1 genetics of Reed-Sternberg cells and anti-PD-1 results; only CS1001 has a published read-out, described as limited.
label: Hodgkin lymphoma (anti-PD-L1)

engagement.note: In-vitro assays showed sugemalimab binds human PD-L1 and blocks PD-1 binding; no human occupancy yet measured.
engagement.short: In vitro: binds and blocks PD-L1
engagement.quote: The results from the in vitro studies demonstrated that sugemalimab bound to human PD-L1, competitively blocked binding of PD-L1 to PD-1 and induced the proliferation of CD4+ T-lymphocytes and the production of IFN-γ and IL-2.
engagement.confidence_note: First-use year 2016 is a proxy from the nonclinical study codes (BCG-PS-16033, 0002-16010) in the EPAR; the in-vitro reports themselves are not public. model_kind ex_vivo because the enum has no in-vitro cell-line value.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry at the assays' first use, before the first-in-human study.
engagement.population: Advanced solid tumours or lymphomas (phase 1; 5 of 29 phase 1a patients had cHL)
engagement.model: In-vitro PD-L1 binding and PD-1 blockade assays (engineered PD-L1/PD-1 cell lines, CD4+ T-cell proliferation)

engagement.note: At 10 mg/kg and 1200 mg Q3W, PD-L1 receptor occupancy on circulating CD3+ T cells was 100% at trough in all 7 evaluable phase 1a patients. Dated 2022 under the earliest-date rule (Gong 2022 epub 2022-01-05), before the 2024 EPAR.
engagement.quote: At the time point of C2D1 pre-dose, CD3+ T cells from 7 evaluable patients showed 100% RO.
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC9293819, CS1001-101 phase 1a, NCT03312842; 29 patients, 5 with cHL; not stated whether any cHL patient was among the 7 RO-evaluable). The EPAR repeats the occupancy for phase 1b (5 and 3 evaluable patients, 100% RO). The in-vitro side is public only in the 2024 EPAR. The cHL phase 2 (CS1001-202, NCT03505996) used 1200 mg Q3W.
engagement.judgement: Judgement call: the in-vitro assays predict that sugemalimab occupies PD-L1; flow-cytometric receptor occupancy on circulating leukocytes is a direct readout of that, and it was saturated. Paired by me (comparison_stated false): the EPAR reports the assays and the occupancy in the same section but does not set them against each other. Only sugemalimab has engagement data; tagitanlimab and benmelstobart have none public.
engagement.magnitude_basis: PD-L1 receptor occupancy on peripheral CD3+ T cells at C2D1 trough
engagement.population: Advanced solid tumours or lymphomas (phase 1; 5 of 29 phase 1a patients had cHL)
engagement.model: In-vitro PD-L1 binding and PD-1 blockade assays (engineered PD-L1/PD-1 cell lines, CD4+ T-cell proliferation)

dose.note: Repeat-dose cynomolgus toxicology set a NOAEL of 200 mg/kg, a tolerability margin over the planned human exposure.
dose.quote: The proposed NOAEL of 200mg/kg in the 4w exposure study was acceptable (animal-to-human exposure margin of Cmax ~21x-26x and AUC ~21x-23x).
dose.confidence_note: First-use year 2016 is a proxy (GLP studies precede the first-in-human study registered 2017); the toxicology reports are not public, only the EPAR summary.
dose.judgement: Opening entry: the toxicology package that stated the tolerability margin before patients were dosed.
dose.population: Advanced solid tumours or lymphomas (phase 1; 5 of 29 phase 1a patients had cHL)
dose.model: Cynomolgus monkey repeat-dose toxicology (4- and 26-week GLP studies, NOAEL 200 mg/kg)

dose.note: Phase 1a patients (5 of 29 with cHL) were dosed 3-40 mg/kg and 1200 mg Q3W with no DLT and no MTD; the cHL phase 2 then used 1200 mg Q3W. Dated 2022 under the earliest-date rule (Gong 2022 epub 2022-01-05), before the 2024 EPAR.
dose.quote: No DLTs were reported at any dose level, and the MTD was not reached.
dose.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC9293819, CS1001-101 phase 1a, NCT03312842). The NOAEL margin (Cmax ~21-26x) is stated only in the 2024 EPAR against clinical exposure (Cmax 577 µg/mL); the NOAEL of 200 mg/kg lies above every dose tested. No cHL-only tolerability data are published; CS1001-202 (cHL, n=80, 1200 mg Q3W) is pooled in the EPAR safety set.
dose.reason: Margin held; no DLT at 1200 mg
dose.judgement: Judgement call: scored on the dose rule's margin half. The monkey NOAEL stated that exposures far above the clinical one were tolerated; patients were dosed to the chosen 1200 mg Q3W regimen without dose-limiting toxicity, so same with margin_stated true. The model stated no efficacy exposure target, so this says nothing about whether 1200 mg was enough in cHL. Paired by me from two EPAR sections (comparison_stated false). Sugemalimab only.
dose.population: Advanced solid tumours or lymphomas (phase 1; 5 of 29 phase 1a patients had cHL)
dose.model: Cynomolgus monkey repeat-dose toxicology (4- and 26-week GLP studies, NOAEL 200 mg/kg)

efficacy.population: Unselected (relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma)
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PubMed 27069084). The cohort was treated with Stanford V chemotherapy, not a PD-L1 antibody.
efficacy.model: 9p24.1/PD-L1 genetics of Reed-Sternberg cells (patient biopsies, FISH)
efficacy.note: 97% of cHL biopsies carried 9p24.1 alterations raising PD-L1 and PD-L2, the rationale for blocking the PD-1 axis; no member drug tested yet. Opens the sugemalimab IV track, the only member with a cHL read-out.
efficacy.quote: PD-L1/PD-L2 alterations are a defining feature of cHL.
efficacy.judgement: Opening entry: the patient-genetic system that underpins PD-1-axis blockade in cHL, described before any member entered cHL patients (first member trial registered 2018-04-23). No member drug was involved, so product_in_model false.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: objective response to CS1001 in relapsed cHL, reported only qualitatively as limited
efficacy.population: Unselected (relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma)
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text read (PMC8722342). The CS1001 phase 2 (NCT03505996, 82 enrolled, ORR primary) has no posted or peer-reviewed results; 'limited efficacy' is the investigators' qualitative statement. The 9p24.1 data cover five non-responders only. KL-A167 (NCT03580564, 109 enrolled, completed 2020) and TQB2450 (NCT03800706, status unknown) cHL phase 2s have no posted or published results; patient_trials quotes are registry titles. Under the single-arm ruling the status should rest on the ORR value, which is not public; contra rests on the investigators' qualitative statement. Benmelstobart phase 1 (1 of 3 Hodgkin patients PR) is a patient_trials item only. CStone said in 2020 a cHL NDA depended on the data; none was filed (tier 5).
efficacy.model: 9p24.1/PD-L1 genetics of Reed-Sternberg cells (patient biopsies, FISH)
efficacy.note: Single-arm phase 2 (CS1001-202) with IRRC-assessed ORR as primary endpoint and no success bar registered; the ORR value is unreported and the investigators call CS1001 efficacy limited. Five primary-refractory CS1001 non-responders all had 9p24.1 amplification, and four later responded to anti-PD-1.
efficacy.quote: PD-L1 inhibitors blocking only the PD-L1/PD-1 immune checkpoint had limited efficacy in the iMATRIX trial (atezolizumab) [7] and a phase II clinical trial (CS1001; clicnialtrials.gov identifier : NCT03505996 ).

patient_trials.quote: An Open, Multicenter Phase II Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of KL-A167 Injection in Relapsed or Refractory Classical Hodgkin's Lymphoma
A Phase II Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of TQB2450 Injection in Relapsed or Refractory Classical Hodgkin's Lymphoma
achieved an ORR of 33.3% in Hodgkin's lymphoma

efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: the genetics predict that PD-L1 overexpression makes cHL dependent on the PD-1 axis, so blocking PD-L1 should work; the investigators report limited efficacy and amplified non-responders who then responded to anti-PD-1, so contra. Low confidence: the result is qualitative, the trial unpublished, and 9p24.1 also co-amplifies PD-L2, which the authors offer as the reason. Atezolizumab (iMATRIX) is not a member and does not score.
